text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the official Iraqi press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Saddam chairs joint meeting of Revolutionary Command Council and Regional Command of ruling Baath Party.
- $1.4 billion of Iraq's frozen assets in Arab countries.
- Fourth oil supertanker leaves Mina al-Bakr oil terminal after loading with Iraqi crude.
- United Arab Emirates boat loaded with food and medical supplies for Iraqi people arrives at Umm Qasr port in Basra.
(The above stories were also carried by QADISSIYA and JUMHOURIYA)
